build_task: build a BaseTask with two Sawyer robots, props, and initializers for a handshake simulation
build_sawyer_robot: build a Sawyer robot with a Robotiq 2F85 gripper, FTS300 wrist sensor, and arm effector
compose_entities: compose robots and props into a MuJoCo arena by attaching arms and adding free entities
populate_scene_initializers: populate task components with constant pose initializers to position two robots in the scene
build_arena: build an empty MuJoCo arena with custom timestep, gravity, and visualization settings
